steps.en: Install the CLI and register the skill once
steps.zh: 一次性装好 CLI 并注册 skill

steps.en: Connects a daemon to your Chrome over CDP after you allow remote debugging
steps.zh: 你勾选远程调试后，用 CDP 把 daemon 接到 Chrome

steps.en: Drive the attached tab with a Python heredoc
steps.zh: 用 Python heredoc 驱动已附着的标签页

steps.en: Runs pre-imported helpers against that tab without launching a new browser
steps.zh: 用预导入的帮手在该标签页上执行，不再新开浏览器

steps.en: When a helper is missing, write it in the local workspace
steps.zh: 缺帮手时写进本地 workspace

steps.en: Later tasks reuse those helpers; the core package stays untouched
steps.zh: 后续任务复用这些帮手，核心包不被改动

value.en: Your coding agent drives the Chrome you are already logged into, instead of you maintaining a Playwright script per click
value.zh: coding agent 直接驱动你已登录的 Chrome，而不用为每次点击去维护 Playwright 脚本

sources: https://github.com/browser-use/browser-harness/blob/main/SKILL.md Usage (browser-harness heredoc, print(page_info()), first navigation is new_tab)
https://github.com/browser-use/browser-harness/blob/main/README.md How it works (src/browser_harness protected; agent writes agent-workspace/agent_helpers.py)
